'''The Three Stars''' is an [[inn]] in [[Ebou Dar]]. Nothing is known about the location or appearance of the building.

In {{ne|1000}}, [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] tell [[Beslan Mitsobar]] that she is aware of the treasonous meetings he had with [[General]] [[Habiger]] and [[Lord]] [[Malalin]] at The Three Stars.{{ref/book|12|19}}
